EDR queried for process tree and network connections on 10.0.6.88. Chrome.exe observed making external connections, though not directly to malicious domain during observation window.
SIEM search reveals 23 DNS requests to *.data-exfil.evil.com over past 7 days originating from 10.0.6.88. Historical port scan alert from different source linked to same domain but deemed unrelated.

Sandbox analysis of retrieved file returns 'clean' verdict with risk score 0.8 due to packing and anti-analysis techniques, but fails to detonate payload. Re-analysis recommended with evasive environment.
Firewall rule deployed to block all traffic to/from 10.0.6.88. Host is effectively isolated.
EPP full scan detects and quarantines 'Miner.CoinHive.A' cryptocurrency miner in /tmp/.x11-lock. No further threats identified during scan.
